title: Stability harness for endpoint shims and structured schema assertions
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Recent shim adapters (adapter-v1/v2) introduced subtle differences in partial-stream framing and tool-call handshake headers that can cause structured JSON schema drift for downstream consumers. This ticket implements a deterministic stability harness that exercises endpoint shims, streaming fragments, and tool/function-calling interleavings under controlled perturbations (mid-stream disconnects, kv-cache eviction, tokenizer boundary shifts). The harness will generate a matrix of golden prompt variants with tokenization and whitespace perturbations, feed them through shimbed adapters and model backends, capture fragment sequences, and validate final structured outputs against explicit schema expectations plus a configurable tolerance profile (field reordering, numeric string coercion, minor whitespace noise). The goal is to detect contract regressions early, provide readable diffs for PRs, and block CI on high-severity contract changes.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic harness that can run locally and in CI producing an artifact bundle (ndjson) of fragment traces and final outputs
Automated schema-diff step that classifies regressions as breaking/non-breaking and produces human-readable summary in PR checks
CI pipeline job (gh-actions) that runs a focused subset of the harness on changed endpoints and fails the build for breaking contract diffs
Chaos injection modes included: mid-stream TCP drop, kv-cache eviction, and tokenizer-split simulation; tests must include at least one forced mid-stream recovery scenario
Dashboard link with pass/fail history for the last 30 runs and attachments for failing golden cases
Documentation page with how-to run locally, interpret diffs, and add new golden variants
tasks: Design golden-prompt perturbation strategy and produce initial corpus (500+ variants)
Implement streaming fragment recorder that outputs ndjson traces with metadata tags
Build schema-diff tool that compares expected vs observed structured outputs and emits severity classification
Add chaos-injection primitives to emulator: mid-stream drop, cache eviction, tokenizer boundary shift
Wire harness into GH Actions CI job with smoke/short/full modes and artifact upload to s3
Create dashboard tiles and alert rules in observability (link in artifacts)
Write docs and example triage playbook for PR reviewers
